# CanopyChat

> CanopyChat makes a private AI chat app for iPhone, Android and computers, and Canopy Code, a terminal coding agent for developers. Not related to Canopy the humidifier and shower filter brand.

## Canopy Code

- [Canopy Code](https://canopychat.app/canopy-code): The terminal coding agent from CanopyChat. Works with ChatGPT, Claude, API keys and local models (Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM, llama.cpp); switch models mid-session; control it from the CanopyChat app on iPhone. Runs on macOS (Apple silicon), Linux and Windows. Install: `brew install nathanaelguitar/canopy/canopy-code` (macOS, Linux) or Scoop (Windows).
- [Canopy Code: a terminal coding agent for any model, now in VS Code](https://canopychat.app/blog/canopy-code-terminal-coding-agent): Overview and release 2026.11.05 notes, including the VS Code extension.
- [Releases](https://github.com/nathanaelguitar/canopy-code/releases): Binaries and checksums.

## CanopyChat

- [Home](https://canopychat.app/): The CanopyChat app and downloads.
- [Plans](https://canopychat.app/plans): Free, Plus and Pro.
- [Flame](https://canopychat.app/flame): The AI agent in CanopyChat, invite only.
